decision: Offload-to-CPU analysis: the embedding full replica was the only worthwhile candidate and it is already moved (--low_gpu_mem). Everything else is blocked or pointless. KV: Qwen3.5 ForwardGPU hard-asserts !GetKVCacheInCPU (qwen3_5.cpp:15289) and CPU KV is mutually exclusive with FP8 KV (attentionpagedblock.cpp:117). Weights ~4.2 GB/card: no steady-state CPU-resident mechanism (streaming load only trims load-time host RSS); streaming the per-card weights every decode step would be 4.2 GB / ~12 GB/s ≈ 350 ms/token vs the current ~11 ms/token. Per-layer working buffers ~3-4 GB: GPU-resident and constant, prefill chunk 2048/1024/512 all give bigBusy 8283 MB, so chunk shrinking is not a lever either. lm_head TP shard 606 MB is read every decode step; MTP ~250 MB/card is avoidable only by disabling MTP. Remaining levers are compression (FP4 KV halves the 6.56 GB pool) and disabling features, not CPU offload
